purpose: Recommended quote and physical dry-fit baseline; permanent installation remains unreleased
selection_basis: Assistant recommendation responding to the user's request for a practical prototype now, broad upright access, larger useful coverage, and an evergreen handoff. Owner has not ordered a part or accepted final installation.

diverter.aperture_status: Clearance trial; rear factory sealing and mounting footprint remains unmeasured

stocks.use: First metal quote: 0.060 inch stainless. Same STL for a thickness-matched plastic dry-fit print; ask printer to report actual finished thickness.
Clear acrylic / PETG shape trial only. Adds 1.476 mm more depth than T1524. Does not qualify metal stiffness or its exact installed stack.

preferred_material: Quote 316 stainless with deburring and directional graining. Also price 304 #4 brushed protected sheet if cheaper/faster. Appearance need not exactly match Kohler BN; owner judges finish.
locator_decision: No integral bolt tabs or threaded custom holes in FT01. They would constrain an uncertain factory plate pose, obstruct insertion and complicate stud retraction. Center with four equal exposed-border measurements, removable tape and the actual cover. Verify retention under factory clamping and the approved bedding; if it slides, stop and redesign retention, not overtighten.
outer_appearance: Each backing circle concentric with its actual factory cover, constant visible border. Main and diverter border widths need not match each other.

requested_shop_targets.thickness: Use stated stock, report actual thickness range and finishing loss; no silent gauge substitution
requested_shop_targets.edge: Deburr both faces and all aperture edges; remove cutting microtabs, sharp corners, burr and heat tint; preserve contour
requested_shop_targets.finish: Uniform directional satin grain, same direction on both parts, protect visible face. Confirm final cost and lead time. No exact BN match promised.

support: Thin metal is a supported facing/seal landing, not a structural patch spanning unsupported stone damage. Expert must establish firm continuous support at sealing and clamping zones. No tile alteration authorized.

foam.status: Edge-flush foam user-confirmed; actual rear outline, compression and corner radius require physical contact verification

depth: Added height = actual custom thickness + effective support/bedding height. Do not infer permitted engagement from free foam height or a generic 5 mm tolerance.
manufacture_scope: Upload custom-only files for pricing or purchase a sacrificial fit trial. No permanent-installation release, vendor upload or purchase has occurred.
